processing: gains only (every sentence unit to one loudness target; the lifted lines of pt_timing_v3.json a little under on purpose), clip-gain dips on single plosive bursts / small unit trims so the peak stays under -1 dBFS without a limiter; every cut inside true silence with 8 ms fades; pauses set by cutting or by adding true silence; no stretch, no pitch shift, no EQ, no compression. The phone's replay and its laugh bed are band-passed copies (550-3600 Hz) on their own stem.
files: words.json = caption tokens (one per spoken word; CAPS for character lines, digits for numbers: {1,000|a thousand} {6|six} {1.|one.}); words_spoken.json = one entry per spoken word with its line id (the phone replay marked from_phone, at its true audio time); phrases.json = one entry per voiced row (v3 ids, speaker N / D / T / KID); captions.json = the script's own caption chunks with times; stems/ = dialogue + laughs + phone (their sum is voice.wav); segments/ = the swappable openings + the body

timing_plan._doc: The pause plan of the pointing voice, SCRIPT v3 (read by pt3_build.py, pt3_verify.py). Made from SCRIPT_v3.md section 4.2 (and the cut order 4.3). Every value is TRUE silence (10 ms RMS windows every 5 ms under -45 dBFS) between the acoustic end of one line and the first WORD of the next. A pause is cut, or silence is added: the audio is never stretched.

word_onsets_measured._doc: 2026-11-20 (voice owner): word STARTS inside connected speech measured by hand on the dialogue stem (10 ms frames: level, >3 kHz and <400 Hz energy share, spectral peak, f0), where Whisper put the start on the vowel 0.06-0.18 s late. Value = seconds from the start ('on') of the unit that holds the word; key = the word's index in the whole line (0 = first word, not set: moving 'What's' of v3_t03 moves the phone replay and so the AUDIO; its measured onset 24.195 is in NOTES.md). Body pass 2026-11-20: the words the cuts, EV events and beats are anchored on. Convention: a word starts at its first phone, stop closures included (a closure shared by two stops is split in the middle). The build applies a value only when it is within 0.25 s of its own estimate, and lists every move.
